scope: Claim-tier, provenance, ownership, manifest metadata, raw-reconstruction firewall, terminal-success semantics, forbidden language, source edges, and candidate-self-authorization review of the six registered inputs only.

summary.reason: The result promotes rejected divergence outputs to a concrete measurement, the canonical result card does not report the controlling terminal gate, and the manifest's candidate-self-authorization claim is not independently evidenced in the assigned closeout bundle.

findings.title: A failed divergence response is still published and interpreted as a concrete measurement

evidence.detail: The frozen route maps any registered-radius rank/theta-information failure to NON_INFORMATIVE_DIVERGENCE_RESPONSE before later q gates.
divergence_channel_measured is false, but three theta estimate/SD pairs are emitted under divergence_measurements and the interpretation calls them a concrete raw-CF4 divergence-channel measurement.
The same artifact marks the result reproducible and dependency-satisfying while terminating because one or more divergence response/injection gates failed.

assumptions: The frozen terminal order is authoritative.
A field explicitly marked not measured cannot be promoted to an accepted measurement without a per-radius acceptance distinction.
findings.consequence: A downstream consumer can ingest the theta values as accepted observational measurements even though the artifact's own controlling status rejects the divergence channel. This defeats the non-informative firewall and inflates a C3 conditional internal outcome.
findings.required_fix: For NON_INFORMATIVE_DIVERGENCE_RESPONSE, null or quarantine the theta outputs as non-authoritative candidate diagnostics and replace the interpretation with an explicit no-accepted-measurement statement. If only some radii fail, carry an authoritative per-radius accepted/withheld status and call only accepted rows measurements; the aggregate must remain non-informative. Regenerate and rebind the result card and manifest.

findings.title: The terminal provenance and success semantics conflate an identifiability result with a validation failure

evidence.detail: NON_INFORMATIVE is a successful reproducible result only when a registered authority or identifiability gate requires it.
The frozen ordered router distinguishes divergence rank/information failure from unavailable signed q responses, and expects the q-response route pre-PR155 only after the divergence gate passes.

success_dependency_satisfied is true, but terminal_reason only says a response/injection gate failed; it does not identify whether this is a registered identifiability outcome or a failed validation injection.
The canonical card status is NON_INFORMATIVE_DIVERGENCE_RESPONSE, while its mandatory claim language attributes the non-informative result to unavailable q responses, a later non-controlling gate.

assumptions: A failed deterministic or covariance validation injection is process/validation failure, not scientific non-identification.
A dependency-satisfying terminal must name the exact frozen gate that authorizes success.
findings.consequence: The bundle can close successfully even if the actual blocker was a failed validation injection, and its public-facing internal card hides the earliest controlling failure behind the already-known q-response absence.
findings.required_fix: Emit exact failed gate IDs and primitives. Set success_dependency_satisfied=true only when the earliest failure is a frozen rank/theta-information identifiability gate; set it false for any deterministic/covariance injection validation failure. Make mandatory_claim_language report the controlling divergence terminal first, with q-response absence only as a secondary blocked gate.

findings.title: candidate_cannot_authorize_itself is an unevidenced candidate assertion in the assigned bundle

evidence.detail: The generated candidate manifest hashes its own generated artifacts and then sets candidate_cannot_authorize_itself=true.
The top-level source edges are opaque content hashes only; none names an independent verifier identity, external authorization receipt, or mutation verdict that derives the boolean.
authority_ok=true and raw_reconstruction_values_used=[] are assertions in another artifact produced by the same candidate generation.

assumptions: Content-addressing a candidate pack provides integrity but does not by itself provide independent authorization.
The assignment's six-file evidence boundary is the closeout evidence available to this reviewer.
findings.consequence: A coherently resealed generation can repeat the authorization and raw-firewall assertions without the final manifest showing which non-candidate authority recomputed and rejected forged values.
findings.required_fix: Replace the bare boolean with a hash-bound reference to an independent verifier/adjudication receipt rooted outside the candidate generation, including verifier identity and bytes, the frozen authority root, exact recomputation command, and a mutation proving that resealed authority_ok/raw-use/source-edge drift is rejected. Until then mark the check pending or unverified.

passing_checks.detail: All six required-input SHA-256 values exactly match the assignment. The manifest hashes for the three assigned generated children also match their files.

The reviewed generated artifacts consistently carry OBSSTAT ownership, obsstat implementation scope, conditional C3, standard_internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, config/input hashes, sky/mask/covariance/null status, caveats, command, and Git/content state.

No positive detection, significance, acceleration, global-tilt, cosmological-anisotropy, geometry, family-identification, or transfer-validation claim appears; occurrences are null fields, forbidden-use lists, or explicit negations.

The reviewed result surfaces do not name Vpds, Vpwf, or Vpec as inputs or truth, and source_authority records raw_reconstruction_values_used=[]; computational enforcement is not independently demonstrated by the six assigned files, as captured in finding 003.

The primary-source record authenticates formula/convention provenance only, requires separate signed CF4-window response bridges, and explicitly disclaims physical applicability, acceleration, cosmology, geometry, family, and transfer conclusions.

The spec, compact-CF4, PR-card semantic, and relevant-content hashes are internally consistent across the assigned spec, source-authority record, metadata, and manifest. Independent authorization of those edges is not demonstrated in the assigned bundle.
